what: When the text crosses the 80% line of the screen, its letters light up one by one from the start, transparent 0→1 (.25s power1.out · paragraphs at .02s · big titles at .05s intervals). Scrolling back above the line turns them off in the same order over .15s power1.in, and they light up again on the way down — the space is reserved from the start so lines never shift

options.each: Stagger between characters (s), default .02 — large title .05
options.dur: Time for one letter to light up (s), default .25
options.back: Fade-out length (s), default .15 — at 0 it won’t fade out even when reversed
options.base: Opacity of dimmed letters, default 0 (original textReveal default .2)
options.on: If “state”, it does not watch scroll and is turned on and off only by fx:show · fx:hide events (step text of a pinned scene)
options.order: With ”shuffle” the letters turn on not from the front but in a shuffled order on a 12-character cycle (0,1,4,3,2,7,6,5,9,8,11,10) — Brand mono label. With ”reverse” they start from the last letter
options.ease: Entry easing curve (four cubic-bezier numbers or a GSAP name), default power1.out — full-video-corporate-shipping 0.55,0.085,0.68,0.53
options.pause: Delays the character after a period (. 。) by this many seconds instead of each — if absent, always each. Brand body .3
options.y: Letters turn on while moving into place from this many px below, default 0 — Brand hero text 4 (.12s · .018 gap · on: state)
options.spread: Spreads the delay from the first to the last character evenly over this length (sec) (one char = spread ÷ character count including spaces) — if given, used instead of each. registered-commons .5
options.delay: Seconds to wait before turning on, default 0 — the line under the title is drawn first, then the text arrives (registered-commons .5)
options.ease-y: The rising curve is separate from the opacity curve (ease) — only when y is present. registered-commons slide 0.5,0.5,0,0.95 · appear 0.45,0.25,0,0.95
